name: Tobias
description: Father of Hircanus, a man of great dignity, named when Simon misinformed the governor about money laid up in the temple treasury

points: The high priest told him that there was such money laid up for the relief of widows and fatherless children, and that some of it belonged to Hircanus son of Tobias, a man of great dignity, and not as that wicked Simon had misinformed: in all four hundred talents of silver and two hundred of gold. And that it was altogether impossible that such wrong should be done unto them that had committed it to the holiness of the place.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
